## 🌺 Florida 2022 Gubernatorial Election Map 🌷

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
# Load county election data
county_data <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__county.csv")

# Filter for the Governor race and calculate Republican vote percentage
gov_results <- county_data |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party %in% c("DEM", "REP")) |>
  group_by(county) |>
  summarize(
    rep_votes = sum(votes[party == "REP"]),
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    rep_pct = (rep_votes / total_votes) * 100
  ) |>
  mutate(county = if_else(county == "Desoto", "DeSoto", county))
```

```{r}
#| label: map
# Get Florida county boundaries and transform for leaflet
fl_map <- counties(state = "FL", cb = TRUE) |>
  left_join(gov_results, by = c("NAME" = "county")) |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Pink flower theme palette
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#fff0f5", "#fbb4b9", "#f768a1", "#c51b8a", "#7a0177"),
  domain = c(0, 100)
)

# Render interactive leaflet map with pink styling and flower accents
leaflet(fl_map) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(rep_pct),
    weight = 1.5,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "#ffc0cb",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 3,
      color = "#ff1493",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~paste0("🌸 ", NAME, " County: ", round(rep_pct, 1), "% REP 🌺")
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~rep_pct,
    opacity = 0.8,
    title = "🌸 REP Vote % 🌸",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
